candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show order spans failing with 500 Internal Server Error for every checkout correlation ID, while gateway /healthz and /readyz stay 200.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the order 500 (code defect vs dependency) is not established; order logs/metrics were excluded from context.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s correlate one-to-one with order POST /v1/orders returning 500 in traces; gateway health endpoints remain 200, so the failure originates downstream in the order service. The order deployment record (1.0.0 to 2.0.0) does not by itself establish causation. Order logs and metrics were excluded, so the specific order-side fault is not yet bounded.
